1. (Currently Amended) A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, __and wherein the membrane (10) has a resonant frequency below 200 Hz__.

2. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone __and the membrane (10) is formed by injection molding of the silicone elastomer__.

3. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 or 2, wherein the membrane (10) is injection moulded __and the elastomer has a Young's modulus below 50 MPa__.

4. (Original) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

5. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), __and wherein the stiffening element (16) is positioned to provide localized stiffening only to the flat central region__.

6. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, further comprising a support structure (32,34) which defines a back volume (36), wherein the back volume is less than 1cm3 __and the support structure is configured for use in a communication device having a thickness constraint requiring the back volume to be minimized__.

7. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 6, wherein the back volume (36) is less than 0.5cm3 __and the speaker is configured for integration into a handheld communication device__.

8. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the resonant frequency is below 300 Hz __and above 200 Hz__.

9. (Currently Amended) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the resonant frequency is below 250 Hz __and above 200 Hz__.

10. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa __and a resonant frequency below 200 Hz__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).

11. (Currently Amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises silicone __and the forming step comprises injection molding of the silicone elastomer__.

12. (Original) A method as claimed in claim 10 or 11, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

13. (Currently Amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, 11 or 12, wherein the membrane (10) is formed using injection moulding __and the elastomer has a Young's modulus below 50 MPa__.

14. (Currently Amended) A method as claimed in any one of claims 10 to 13, wherein the membrane (10) is formed with a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the method further comprises providing a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane to the coil (8), __wherein the stiffening element (16) is positioned to provide localized stiffening only to the flat central region__.
